Definition: Jeush, the name of an Edomite and of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jehush or Jeush = "He hurries to aid"; 1) son of Eshek, a remote descendant of king Saul; 2) a Gershonite Levite of the house of Shimei; 3) son of king Rehoboam of Judah
